scope: Fresh finite two-job decision study on an inherited frozen learned HCSN content decoder. This is not joint backbone training, native Rust Hepta integration, or multimodal pretraining.
content_adapter: Unchanged third/memory/reference.py FullHX NumPy recurrence and mass read; frozen checkpoint, full four logits retained, observed class is argmax of known binary classes 0 and 1.
data_contract: Independent binary hidden label for each of two jobs. Each packet contains an independently noisy symbol conditional on the current job label. READ loads a JSON token packet and runs the inherited learned content decoder. Public reliability and read-price schedules are available to every policy; labels and unread symbols are never policy inputs.
reward: Each FIRE earns +1 for correct or -1 for incorrect answer. READ incurs public multiplier times packet price. STOP forfeits remaining jobs and is terminal. No forced answer at the deadline.
reset: FIRE resets job posterior to 0.5, advances job index, and consumes the firing tick plus one refractory tick. The read budget is shared across the two jobs. Every packet decoder starts its own content sequence from the original zero state.
oracle: Exact finite Bellman recursion for the TRAIN-calibrated binary decoder-error model. Observations are integrated using conditional probabilities, not actual future labels or packet contents. This is model-exact, not a proof that the fitted error law is the true deployment law.
calibration: Empirical TRAIN-only 2x2 decoder confusion matrix with fixed Jeffreys pseudocount 0.5 in each cell; both hidden noisy-symbol classes represented equally.
learning: Three identical linear four-action readouts over the same fixed nonlinear features, same training states and train-only standardization. Learned-value targets full Bellman Q; ordinary-boundary targets one-hot full-DP action; first-event targets Q with zero post-FIRE continuation. Ridge candidates and fitting counts are identical.
selection: Validation target MSE for value regressors; validation action disagreement for ordinary classifier, ties resolved by smaller ridge. No test-driven refits or choices.
primary_contrasts: Learned-value minus ordinary-boundary mean realized reward-minus-charged-read-cost at each of three public cost multipliers. Five paired cohort/fit differences; report Student-t intervals and Bonferroni family 95% intervals. Gate requires corrected lower bound above zero at primary multiplier 1.5; no fallback endpoint.
secondary: All policy quality, completed jobs, READ/SKIP/FIRE/STOP counts, first-event ablation, DP model gap, complete CPU/wall and setup amortization. These cannot replace a failed primary contrast.
cost_accounting: Runtime includes public metadata I/O, policy computation, actual packet I/O, feature construction, inherited content inference, state dispatch, and trace serialization. Separately report data construction, content loading/calibration, oracle-label preparation, all candidate fitting/validation and initial source imports. Shared CPU timings are observations, not energy or hardware-general guarantees.
freshness: Entirely new session/packet RNG bases; hash every packet, metadata and evaluator-only label file; require disjoint packet bytes among fresh train/validation/test cohorts. Historical content model and historical task family are reused explicitly.
validation: Real SKIP before file open/content invocation; terminal STOP rejection; changed read payload changes decoder output; unread-payload changes do not affect a stopped result; serialize/reload continuation matches uninterrupted actions and outputs; finite one-step Bellman values checked against closed-form enumeration.
limits: Frozen inherited content weights; controller readouts are fitted, not a new large neural backbone
Finite synthetic iid two-job tasks; not real multimodal data
No native Hepta production owner was invoked
Timing and statistical superiority gates are separate from integrity and causality tests
